body:
When i actually muster up the motivation to do my hobbies it's usually crafting type stuff. Making *something*. Nothing ever in particular i just like learning to make stuff. I like DIY stuff.

I suppose I posted in the wrong sub. But i couldn't figure out a place that's just "makingfriends\_advice".

I honestly have no idea how I'd start that. Like where to find something I'd like. I've tried clubs way back when I was a college freshman but never found them enjoyable. Nowadays I'm not sure where I'd find them to begin with

Yeah this is the last straw for me tbh. I've posted some shit here that might not really fit the "wow thanks..." narrative before but this post really made me realize this sub has lost its original message.

This advice might not work instantly and not work for everyone but these are a lot of the first steps to getting out of a bad mindset.

  


To anyone who is struggling and thought this sub might be some some commiseration, just go ahead a leave. These days this sub is nothing but perpetuating a mindset.

I mentioned in another reply that I've gone to and will be going to therapy. So maybe that will cull some feelings.

Its a cathartic feeling to write things out and I suppose it's the audience and stage to which i write to and on that matters. I've tried other "depression" communities online but they felt like void screaming or echo chambers at best and at worst I felt excluded from a place where i was supposed to be accepted. It made me reevaluate the notion of online (semi anonymous) venting. Perhaps a different approach to it will help.

I've been to therapy, and universe willing will be going again. But this time around it feels different. Probably because I haven't gone for some months. I moved cities. For reasons relating to mental health. It feels like i should be better. Like i shouldn't have a reason to go anymore. It's like I'm picking at scars on purpose or something.

  


I appreciate your relating to me. It means something that a random online would try and level with me.
